set.request: URGENT. On the Dictate card the Overview shows all 13 requests as unticked To do and 0 Delivered, as a flat list with no groups. (1) A request counts as delivered if it has status done, OR a later manager- message whose text begins Landed, OR an add_item done line; count it against the 13 real page.jsonl files. (2) Overview is the summary: what the card is, its state, Delivered N · To do M, and the three groups (latest group line wins) with each request under its group, ticked if delivered. (3) Tabs are routed child urls (…/tasks/), a reload lands on the same tab, no 404. Verify headless at 1920.
steps: Count delivered from the 13 page.jsonl files
Delivered rule + grouped Overview in card.js
Headless at 1920: Overview, /tasks/, reload, zero console errors
